rows.statement: Every frozen finite deterministic network of finite-state local units with finite topology/configuration state is exactly representable as one deterministic finite-state transducer whose global state is the Cartesian product of local and topology states.
rows.consequence: Local adaptive-unit decomposition is not a new finite expressivity class; residuals must be resource/factorization/developmental.

rows.statement: At the registered two-node binary structured grammar, state adaptation and topology adaptation produce different developmental phenotype sets; allowing both yields additional interaction-only phenotypes.
rows.claim_boundary: Fixed grammar/resource bound only; finite-state parent sufficient for expressivity.

rows.statement: In the registered one-example binary-label ecology, local-state storage and topology/edge storage are both perfect but Pareto-distinct; under the registered scalarization topology wins iff w_state > 2*w_desc + w_edge + H*w_message.
rows.claim_boundary: Calibrates frontier/phase machinery; no GMI novelty.

rows.statement: A tiny finite cross-paradigm representability demonstration cannot establish a common intelligence substrate because finite target behavior/update can be flattened into a finite table/transducer.
rows.consequence: Stage D must test families/scaling and bounded developmental compilation.

rows.statement: Morphogenesis questions should separate basis closure M_B, developmental feasible/frontier set F_B(E), and search dynamics Gamma; a wrong frontier prediction is distinct from a search failure.

Expressive universality, finite local adaptive structure, and description minimality do not currently identify a representation-independent unique cognitive atom; the live target is a resource-bounded equivalence class of execution/development bases.
rows.boundary: Does not prove that no stronger physically/resource-defined unique basis can exist.

rows.statement: A shared basis preserves the native scaling/update structure of at least neural, symbolic, probabilistic and programmatic morphology families under a frozen bounded-compilation class without architecture-labelled macros.

For at least one disjoint ecology coordinate change, the complete/faithfully estimated developmental morphology frontier changes in a quantitatively predicted way before protected search, and neutral search subsequently recovers the predicted frontier classes.
rows.required_residual: endogenous morphology generation + developmental cost + pre-search frontier prediction + blind recovery
